body.intro: Discussing pay has always been awkward, especially when you step into a conversation without knowing where you actually stand. Most people are forced to rely on uncomfortable whispers with colleagues or outdated annual reports to guess their true market value.
body.outro: Our mission is straightforward: to equip every worker with the hard data needed to negotiate compensation confidently. When pay data is transparent, the wage gap shrinks and everyone benefits.

1.title: Real-Time Data
1.body: Every score blends live job postings with official federal BLS benchmarks, refreshed continuously.

2.title: No Guesswork
2.body: Get a definitive MCA Score from 1-99 instead of a vague 'ballpark' salary range.

3.title: Built For Negotiation
3.body: Walk into your next review with evidence, not just instinct.

body.bold: Data-driven alignment is the key to a fair and efficient job market.
body.intro: Historically, a position's true market value has been a moving target, clouded by stale data and unreliable reporting. This disconnect makes it tough for companies to remain competitive and for job seekers to understand their true worth.
body.middle: {app-name} was developed to bridge this informational gap through real-time data integration.
body.outro: The platform's mission is to provide an objective, data-backed standard for salary transparency. By cross-referencing over 7,000,000 active job openings with federal benchmarks, we ensure every hiring decision and career move is grounded in today's market reality, fostering a more equitable landscape for everyone.

1.title: Live Market Signal
1.body: Every benchmark blends 7,000,000+ active job postings with official federal BLS data, refreshed continuously.

2.title: Objective Scoring
2.body: Replace 'gut feel' compensation bands with a definitive MCA Score employers and candidates both trust.

3.title: Built For Hiring Decisions
3.body: Validate an offer before you post it, and defend it with confidence when you extend it.
